svg.title: System Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: Diagram showing system layers: User Interface, API Gateway, Agent Core, Tools Sandbox, Local Storage

g.text: Layer 1: User Interface - Next.js 16 Client with Live Execution Trace
Layer 2: API & Task Router - FastAPI Server with Heuristic Routing
Layer 3: Agent Core - Local Ollama Model (qwen2.5:1.5b-instruct)
Layer 4: Tools Sandbox - Sandboxed OCR, Python Exec, Document Tools
Layer 5: Local Storage - ChromaDB Vector Store & Workspace Sandbox
